dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast perimeters. The geometry is defined by thin, high-intensity white/grey lines transitioning abruptly to darker interior and exterior matrices, particularly in the mid-lateral section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-gradient, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated along the ventral-lateral transition. These blobs appear as solid, non-circular speckles interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-body region form an irregular quadrilateral with a longitudinal orientation, while three distinct blobs near the posterior-midsection form a nearly equilateral triangle.
